terms.name: Models
terms.description: BIM / 3D models exchanged between authoring and coordination tools.

terms.name: Drawings
terms.description: 2D sheets and plans (DWG/PDF) shared across design and field tools.

terms.name: Specifications
terms.description: Specification sections defining materials, products, and execution standards.

terms.name: Bids & Tenders
terms.description: Bid / tender packages and procurement solicitations exchanged during buyout.

terms.name: Commitments & Contracts
terms.description: Executed commitments — subcontracts and purchase orders — that draw down the budget.

terms.name: Budgets
terms.description: The project budget and its budget line items.

terms.name: Cost Codes
terms.description: The cost-code / cost-breakdown structure that line items are coded to.

terms.name: Change Orders
terms.description: Change orders and potential change events that adjust scope or cost.

terms.name: Invoices & Payments
terms.description: Invoices, pay applications, and payment records.

terms.name: Schedules
terms.description: Project schedules (CPM / Gantt) and their activities.

terms.name: RFIs
terms.description: Requests for Information and their responses.

terms.name: Submittals
terms.description: Submittal packages (shop drawings, product data, samples) and their review.

terms.name: Meetings & Minutes
terms.description: Project meetings and their minutes, agendas, and action items.

terms.name: Daily Logs
terms.description: Daily field logs / site diaries (manpower, weather, progress).

terms.name: Photos
terms.description: Site and progress photos.

terms.name: Inspections
terms.description: Quality and field inspections and their results.

terms.name: Punch Lists
terms.description: Punch / snag lists tracking deficiencies to close out.

terms.name: Time & Labor
terms.description: Timesheets and labor hours.

terms.name: Documents
terms.description: General project documents and files under document management.

terms.name: Directory & Contacts
terms.description: The project / company directory of people and companies.
